paragraphs: Read everything that decides who a campaign contacts and what it says — the app's Campaign tab in one call. Who it targets: offer, customer_problem, target_role, target_geography, target_company_size, positive_criteria, negative_criteria, example_clients, and the derived keywords. What it says: instructions (first email), followup_instructions (shared by every follow-up), language, and the project-level reply_instructions. When it says it: schedule (the send days) and followups (how many emails the sequence has and how far apart — a project-level setting, the same for every campaign of the project). targeting_editable is false for a campaign built from your own imported lead list — its audience is that list, so the targeting fields are locked. Free, and the natural first call when auditing an account: one request per campaign tells you whether it is aimed at the right people, before a single email goes out.
